 प्रथम वर्ष अभिय ांत्रिकी पदवी[B.Tech(UG) 1st Year] अभ्य सक्रम स ठी केंद्रीिूत प्रथम वर्ष प्रवेश प्रक्रक्रय  
(CAP ROUND) स ठी प्रवेश इच्छुक ववद्य र्थय ांकडे ख लील शैक्षणिक व इतर क गदपिे असिे आवश्यक आहे. 
   Eligibility: Passed 10+2 examination or its equivalent examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects  
along with Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subject/Computer Science/Information Technology/ 
Informatics Practices/Agriculture/Engineering Graphics/Business Studies/Electronics/Entrepreneurship and obtained at 
least 45% (at least 40% marks, in case of Reserved categories, EWS and PWD candidates belonging to the Maharashtra 
State only) in the above subjects taken together and The Candidate should have appeared in all the subjects in PCM MHT-
CET/JEE  and obtained non zero score in PCM MHT-CET/JEE conducted by the Competent Authority. 
   [NOTE: Candidates having only JEE score card are eligible for All India quota (15%) only.] 
 
 
 
 
 
 
OR 
Passed minimum three years Diploma in Engineering and Technology and obtained at least 45% marks (at least 40% 
marks, in case of Reserved categories, EWS and PWD candidates belonging to the Maharashtra State only). 
OR 
Passed three years Diploma of Vocation (D.Voc.) stream in the same or allied sector;

In addition to the above documents the candidates of TYPE-A & B are required 
to produce the following additional documents depending upon the category to 
which they belong. (इतर आरक्षि स ठी ल गि रे ज स्तीचे क गदपिे ) 
1) Defence (डडफेंस) साठी Proforma-C  आणण सोबत आई/वडील (Mother/Father) यांपैर्ी 
एर्ाचे Domicile सर्टक्रफर्ेट पार्हजे.(रर्हवाशी चालत नाही) 
2) Orphan(अनाथ) साठी संबंधधत अधधर्ाऱ्याचे प्रमाणपत्र आवश्यर् आहे. (Orphan 
Certificate Proforma – U) 
3) PWD(अपंग) साठी ससववल हॉष्ट्पपटल (CIVIL Hospital) चे 40% पेक्षा जापत 
अपंगत्व असल्याचे प्रमाणपत्र. (udid र्ाडक चालत नाही).  
  
  II) Type – C Candidates:(Applicable for GoI(Central) Employees in case candidature 
TYPE-A & B is not applicable) 
  
 
Certificate from the employer in the proforma – A stating that father/mother of 
the candidate who is a Central Government / Government of India undertaking employee 
is presently posted in Maharashtra. 
 
  III) Type–D Candidates: :(Applicable for Maharashtra Govt. Employees in case 
candidature TYPE-A,B & C is not applicable)

the candidate who is a Maharashtra State Government / Maharashtra State Government 
undertaking employee.

of settlement. 
 
  IV) Type-E Candidates Maharashtra Karnataka border area Candidates

     in proforma – G1.

     (List of the villages in Maharashtra Karnataka border area is available on website)
